newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weakens on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weakens on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was slightly firmer against the dollar but weakened versus the pound on Thursday, commercial bank foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 19.9535 for one dollar from 19.9555 on Wednesday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean of 33.4335 from 33.3840 on Wednesday.
Dealers said the rupee's fixing reflected the dollar's trend in the overnight international markets.
"On the local front, things are very quiet. Foreign exchange demand is not strong at this period of year and commercial banks are long in their (forex) reserves," one dealer said.
The dealer added activity is expected to pick up in mid- January after the end of year festivities.

Commercial banks were seen to be long in their foreign exchange positions after regular central banks market interventions during the past weeks and also owing to hard currency inflow from the tourism sector which is presently at its summer peak season.
